title: Photo avatar (2.5D puppet)
description: A cut-out photo or illustration animated as a talking 2.5D puppet: the jaw drops with the voice (mouth curve from tools/mouth_curve.py) over a dark inner mouth with a teeth hint, gentle head sway and tilt, breathing, seeded blinks. Full frame or in a rounded lower card with the head popping out over its edge. Free and local.

image.description: Cut-out PNG (transparent background, from tools/cutout.py) or an illustration, relative to the scene folder. Head and shoulders, mouth closed, 1000 px wide or more. Only a picture of someone who documented their consent.

landmarks.description: Face points in IMAGE pixels. mouth: centre of the line where the lips meet, w = corner to corner, curve = px the corners sit above the centre (negative: below). eyes: centre, width, opening height of each eye ([] turns blinks off). chin: lowest point of the chin. head: optional ellipse {x, y, rx, ry} around head and hair (null: estimated from eyes and chin). Fill by looking at the image, or run tools/avatar/landmarks.py.

mouthCurve.description: Path (relative to the scene) of a mouth curve JSON from tools/mouth_curve.py, e.g. assets/mouth.json. Empty: a seeded demo curve for layout checks only (not in sync with any audio).

voiceOffset.description: Second of the voice-over at which this scene starts (scene time 0 reads the curve at voiceOffset).

jaw.description: Jaw drop in image px at full opening. 0: automatic (0.3 x mouth width).

openGain.description: Multiplies the mouth curve (0.6 = calmer mouth, 1.3 = bigger).

upperLip.description: How far the upper lip lifts, as a share of the jaw drop.

teeth.description: Teeth hint strength 0..1 (0 = dark mouth only).

motion.description: Head sway, tilt, turn and nod amount (0 = still, 1 = natural, 1.5 = lively).

blinks.description: Seeded blinks (an eyelid slides down using the skin above each eye). Turn off if a still shows smears.

seed.description: Seed for head motion and blink times.

layout.description: lower-card: rounded card in the lower ~45 % with the head popping out over its top edge (graphics go above). full: the avatar fills the frame from the bottom.

avatarScale.description: Size multiplier for the avatar (1 = image as wide as the card, or as the frame in full layout).

avatarOffset.description: [x, y] shift of the avatar in frame px.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the title (empty hides it).

title.description: Title in the upper area; {word} marks the accent word. Empty hides it.

duration.description: Scene length in seconds (5 s fits the intro/outro pattern).

checks: consent: the person in the image agreed in writing (illustrations of no real person need none)
stills at open mouth: no smear above the upper lip or at the mouth corners; teeth read as a hint, not a strip
stills mid-blink: the lid looks like skin; if not, set blinks false
